welcome_page.title: Cycling – Comfort
welcome_page.image_alt: #Bicycle and a route between two points
welcome_page.description:
Slopes, signs, bike parking and your surroundings when you cycle.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name. Giving your email is optional; the SmartUrbanity privacy notice explains how it is protected and how answers are used.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: Do hills and slopes change how you cycle?

options.text: No, they don't affect me
I notice them, but they don't change my trip
They slow me down or tire me a lot
I avoid steep roads when I can
They limit where I can cycle

questions.text: Do signs for cyclists help you find your way?

options.text: I find my way easily, with or without signs
Signs help me now and then
I use signs to check I'm on the right route
Missing or unclear signs sometimes make me lose my way
Signs are so poor that I need my phone to find the way

questions.text: Where you go most often, is there a good place to leave your bike?
questions.help: Safe means your bike is protected from theft, for example a rack you can lock it to.

options.text: No, there is nowhere safe to leave it
There is some, but too little or too far away
Yes, but it isn't always handy or safe
Yes, I can usually find a good place
Yes, always safe and handy

questions.text: Has the lack of safe bike parking ever made you change plans or leave your bike at home?

options.text: Never
Rarely
Sometimes
Often
Always

questions.text: When you cycle, how much does traffic noise bother or annoy you?

options.text: Not at all
Slightly
Moderately
Very
Extremely

questions.text: When you cycle, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?

options.text: Nothing, it doesn't affect me
I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself, e.g. with a mask or closed windows
I take another route or travel at another time
I travel another way (e.g. by bus instead of on foot)

questions.text: When you cycle, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?

options.text: Nothing changes, I travel as usual
It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
I prepare differently or change route (e.g. clothes, umbrella)
I put off or skip some trips
I travel another way (e.g. by car or bus)

questions.text: When you cycle, what do you do when streets, stops or paths are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?

options.text: It doesn't affect me
I notice it, but carry on as usual
It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
I avoid some stops or stretches
I stop using that route altogether

questions.text: When you cycle, do pleasant or unpleasant surroundings affect how you feel?
questions.help: For example buildings, squares, how cared-for a place is and its general feel.

options.text: No, I don't pay attention to them
I notice them, but they rarely make a difference
Sometimes they affect my mood
They affect a lot how I feel on the way
I sometimes choose a route because it's nicer or more interesting

it.#Do hills and slopes change how you cycl: Le salite cambiano il tuo modo di andare in bici?
it.#I notice them, but they don't change my: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambiano il mio viaggio
it.#They slow me down or tire me a lot: Mi rallentano o mi stancano molto
it.#I avoid steep roads when I can: Evito le strade ripide quando posso
it.#They limit where I can cycle: Limitano dove posso andare in bici
it.#Do signs for cyclists help you find you: I cartelli per i ciclisti ti aiutano a trovare la strada?
it.#I find my way easily, with or without s: Trovo la strada facilmente, con o senza cartelli
it.#Signs help me now and then: I cartelli mi aiutano ogni tanto
it.#I use signs to check I'm on the right r: Uso i cartelli per controllare di essere sulla strada giusta
it.#Missing or unclear signs sometimes make: Cartelli mancanti o poco chiari a volte mi fanno perdere la strada
it.#Signs are so poor that I need my phone: I cartelli sono così scarsi che mi serve il telefono per trovare la strada
it.#Where you go most often, is there a goo: Nei posti dove vai più spesso, c'è un buon posto dove lasciare la bici?
it.#Safe means your bike is protected from: Sicuro significa che la bici è protetta dai furti, per esempio un archetto a cui puoi legarla.
it.#No, there is nowhere safe to leave it: No, non c'è nessun posto sicuro dove lasciarla
it.#There is some, but too little or too fa: Ce n'è qualcuno, ma troppo poco o troppo lontano
it.#Yes, but it isn't always handy or safe: Sì, ma non è sempre comodo o sicuro
it.#Yes, I can usually find a good place: Sì, di solito trovo un buon posto
it.#Has the lack of safe bike parking ever: La mancanza di parcheggi sicuri per la bici ti ha mai fatto cambiare programmi o lasciare la bici a casa?
it.#Your surroundings: Il posto in cui ti muovi
it.#When you cycle, how much does traffic n: Quando vai in bici, quanto ti disturba o ti infastidisce il rumore del traffico?
it.#When you cycle, what do you do when the: Quando vai in bici, cosa fai quando l’aria è cattiva (gas di scarico, polvere, cattivi odori)?
it.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambio nulla
it.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask or c: Mi proteggo, ad es. con una mascherina o i finestrini chiusi
it.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Prendo un altro percorso o mi sposto in un altro orario
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in autobus invece che a piedi)
it.#When you cycle, what do you usually do: Quando vai in bici, cosa fai di solito quando il tempo è brutto (pioggia, vento, freddo o gran caldo)?
it.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Non cambia niente, mi sposto come sempre
it.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: È meno piacevole, ma mi sposto allo stesso modo
it.#I prepare differently or change route (: Mi preparo in modo diverso o cambio percorso (ad es. vestiti, ombrello)
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in auto o autobus)
it.#When you cycle, what do you do when str: Quando vai in bici, cosa fai quando strade, fermate o percorsi sono sporchi o mal tenuti (rifiuti, cattivi odori, vetri rotti)?
it.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Me ne accorgo, ma vado avanti come sempre
it.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: È spiacevole, ma passo lo stesso da lì
it.#I avoid some stops or stretches: Evito alcune fermate o alcuni tratti
it.#I stop using that route altogether: Smetto del tutto di usare quel percorso
it.#When you cycle, do pleasant or unpleasa: Quando vai in bici, l’ambiente intorno, piacevole o sgradevole, influisce su come ti senti?
it.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Per esempio edifici, piazze, quanto un luogo è curato e la sua atmosfera in generale.
it.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Ci faccio caso, ma raramente fanno differenza
it.#Sometimes they affect my mood: A volte influiscono sul mio umore
it.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Influiscono molto su come mi sento lungo la strada
it.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: A volte scelgo un percorso perché è più bello o più interessante
it.#Bicycle and a route between two points: Bicicletta e un percorso tra due punti
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>Slopes, signs, bike parking and your:
Pendenze, segnaletica, parcheggi per le bici e ambiente intorno a te quando vai in bici.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome. Lasciare l'email è facoltativo; l'informativa sulla privacy di SmartUrbanity spiega come viene protetta e come vengono usate le risposte.

fr.#Do hills and slopes change how you cycl: Les côtes et les pentes changent-elles votre façon de faire du vélo ?
fr.#No, they don't affect me: Non, elles ne me gênent pas
fr.#I notice them, but they don't change my: Je les remarque, mais elles ne changent pas mon trajet
fr.#They slow me down or tire me a lot: Elles me ralentissent ou me fatiguent beaucoup
fr.#I avoid steep roads when I can: J'évite les routes raides quand je peux
fr.#They limit where I can cycle: Elles limitent où je peux rouler à vélo
fr.#Do signs for cyclists help you find you: Les panneaux pour les cyclistes vous aident-ils à trouver votre chemin ?

fr.#I use signs to check I'm on the right r: J'utilise les panneaux pour vérifier que je suis sur le bon trajet
fr.#Missing or unclear signs sometimes make: Des panneaux absents ou peu clairs me font parfois perdre mon chemin
fr.#Signs are so poor that I need my phone: Les panneaux sont si mauvais que j'ai besoin de mon téléphone pour trouver mon chemin
fr.#Where you go most often, is there a goo: Là où vous allez le plus souvent, y a-t-il un bon endroit pour laisser votre vélo ?
fr.#Safe means your bike is protected from: Sûr signifie que votre vélo est protégé contre le vol, par exemple un support où l'attacher.
fr.#No, there is nowhere safe to leave it: Non, il n'y a aucun endroit sûr pour le laisser
fr.#There is some, but too little or too fa: Il y en a, mais trop peu ou trop loin
fr.#Yes, but it isn't always handy or safe: Oui, mais ce n'est pas toujours pratique ou sûr
fr.#Yes, I can usually find a good place: Oui, je trouve en général un bon endroit
fr.#Has the lack of safe bike parking ever: Le manque de stationnement sûr pour les vélos vous a-t-il déjà fait changer vos projets ou laisser votre vélo à la maison ?
fr.#When you cycle, how much does traffic n: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, dans quelle mesure le bruit de la circulation vous dérange-t-il ?
fr.#When you cycle, what do you do when the: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, que faites-vous quand l’air est mauvais (gaz d’échappement, poussière, mauvaises odeurs) ?
fr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Je le remarque, mais je ne change rien
fr.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask or c: Je me protège, par ex. avec un masque ou en fermant les fenêtres
fr.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Je prends un autre itinéraire ou je me déplace à un autre moment
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en bus plutôt qu'à pied)
fr.#When you cycle, what do you usually do: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, que faites-vous habituellement quand le temps est mauvais (pluie, vent, froid ou grande chaleur) ?
fr.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Rien ne change, je me déplace comme d'habitude
fr.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: C'est moins agréable, mais je me déplace de la même façon
fr.#I prepare differently or change route (: Je me prépare autrement ou je change d'itinéraire (par ex. vêtements, parapluie)
fr.#I put off or skip some trips: Je reporte ou je saute certains trajets
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en voiture ou en bus)
fr.#When you cycle, what do you do when str: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, que faites-vous quand les rues, les arrêts ou les chemins sont sales ou mal entretenus (déchets, odeurs, verre brisé) ?
fr.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Je le remarque, mais je continue comme d'habitude
fr.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: C'est désagréable, mais je passe quand même par là
fr.#I avoid some stops or stretches: J'évite certains arrêts ou certains tronçons
fr.#When you cycle, do pleasant or unpleasa: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, un cadre agréable ou désagréable influence-t-il ce que vous ressentez ?
fr.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Par exemple les bâtiments, les places, l'entretien d'un lieu et son atmosphère générale.
fr.#No, I don't pay attention to them: Non, je n'y fais pas attention
fr.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Je les remarque, mais elles font rarement une différence
fr.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Elles influencent beaucoup ce que je ressens en chemin
fr.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Je choisis parfois un itinéraire parce qu'il est plus agréable ou plus intéressant
fr.#Bicycle and a route between two points: Vélo et un itinéraire entre deux points
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#<p>Slopes, signs, bike parking and your:
Les pentes, la signalisation, les stationnements pour vélos et votre environnement lorsque vous faites du vélo.
